title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) before first transaction
desc: The system should enforce identity verification (KYC) before any token transfer is executed.
policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §3.4 Customer due diligence and verification https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf

title: Record keeping retention ≥ 5 years
desc: Audit or transaction logs must be kept for at least 5 years, retrievable on demand.
snippet: event Transfer(...); // logs stored on chain + offchain retention
policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §9 Record keeping requirement https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf

title: Beneficial ownership identification
desc: For entity accounts, beneficial owners must be identified and verified as part of KYC flow.
policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §4.4 Beneficial owner identification (derived from general guidelines) https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf

title: Ongoing transaction monitoring / suspicious flags
desc: Transfers exceeding thresholds or patterns should trigger flags / review logic.
snippet: if (amount > threshold) emit SuspiciousTransfer(from, to, amount);
policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §7 Transaction monitoring and reporting obligations https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf

title: Freezing high-risk accounts or sanctions screening
desc: System supports freezing or blocking accounts identified as high risk or sanctioned.
policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §5 Risk mitigation / enhanced due diligence https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf

title: Client identity rule: identity on file prior to transaction
desc: Before executing token-related operations, verify that client identity info is on file compliant with SFC §5.4.
policyRef: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — Code of Conduct paragraph 5.4 https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/guidelines/client-identity-rule-policy/Client-Identity-Rule-Policy---2000-07-01-00_00_00.pdf

title: Timely disclosure of client identity to regulators
desc: Client identity records must be retrievable and deliverable to regulators within required timeframe.
snippet: function exportClientInfo(address who) external view returns (ClientInfo);
policyRef: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — regulators can request identity info within 2 business days https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/guidelines/client-identity-rule-policy/Client-Identity-Rule-Policy---2000-07-01-00_00_00.pdf

title: Record changes in identity / KYC data
desc: When identity or KYC status changes, the system must emit an event for auditability.
snippet: event IdentityUpdated(address indexed who, string reason);
policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §12 (Compliance obligations) — record keeping, control obligations https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf

title: Internal control & compliance function oversight
desc: The token-related operations must respect separation of roles, oversight, and error control.
snippet: // administrative actions only via governance or compliance module
policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §12.1 General compliance obligations https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf

title: Conflicts of interest disclosure & fairness
desc: If token logic includes privileged roles, their actions should be transparent via events or logs.
snippet: event AdminAction(address indexed who, string action);
policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §5 & §11 (fair treatment, disclosure) https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf
